name: Activity Types Register Profile Schema
title: Registers of activity types, profiled from the Registered Item Model
abstract: A profile of the Registered Item Model for governed activity type records in the acttype:ActivityType hierarchy, with related PROV object types and an optional plan.
description: An activity type register governs activity types with identifiers, statuses and change history. Specific activity type classes specialise acttype:ActivityType, a sub-class of rim:RegisterItem. Registered types may be classes used to type individual activity records; those records also inherit register item requirements. Every activity type record uses acttype:activityTypeItemClass and belongs to the acttype:ActivityType hierarchy through rdf:type. Related entity, agent and activity types and an optional prov:Plan describe the expected activity. Further profiles specialise the root and constrain these related types.
